preconditions.description: The size of the function domain n is between 1 and 200.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each value in the function f is between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The minimum k is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(f(k)(x) == f(k+1)(x) for x in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: For all x in the domain, applying the function f k times results in the same output as applying it k+1 times, indicating idempotency.
